CITIZENS TO ADDRESS THE COMMISSION - Any member of the public wishing to make public
comment should notify the chair or secretary of the meeting of their desire to speak, or at the time the
“Public Comment Period” is called, and they will be allowed to speak as required by the statute and the
internal rules as allowed.

 CONSENT AGENDA CONSIDERATION
 Items in this portion of the agenda are considered to be routine and non-controversial by the
 County Commission and may be approved by one motion; however, a member of the County
 Commission may request that an item be removed for separate consideration.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Join us at the Downtown Commons on Saturday, December 5th at 4:30 p.m. for the lighting of the County
Christmas tree followed at 5:00 p.m. by the annual Lighted Christmas Parade presented jointly by
Montgomery County and the City of Clarksville. This year’s theme is “Santa’s Workshop”.
